title: NVDLA BDMA Multi-Surface RTL Repair
summary: Diagnose and repair a multi-surface address-progression defect in the NVDLA BDMA RTL, then validate the change with native Verilator traces.
taskPrompt: Repair the staged NVDLA BDMA RTL so multi-surface transfers use correct source address progression. Work only in the writable vmod/nvdla/bdma source directory, build with the native NVDLA tmake flow inside the prepared task container, and preserve simple, strided, and MC/CVSRAM transfer behavior.
agentMustDo: Read the staged task brief and inspect the writable BDMA RTL source.
Reproduce the public multi-surface output mismatch with the native NVDLA Verilator target.
Repair the defect only in vmod/nvdla/bdma RTL source files.
Run relevant public and regression traces and record the diagnosis in JOURNAL.md.

inputFiles.description: Task scope, native build commands, public symptom, and submission requirements.

inputFiles.name: public_tests
inputFiles.description: One simple passing transfer and one failing multi-surface transfer with visible input and expected data.

evaluation: The evaluator discards the agent's task container, overlays the submitted BDMA RTL directory on a clean pinned NVDLA seed, performs a clean Verilator rebuild, and runs hidden deterministic transfers. Hidden cases cover ordinary two-dimensional regressions and three-to-five-surface copies across MC and CVSRAM. A successful clean build is required but earns no standalone credit. Ordinary regressions contribute 5%, and deep multi-surface cases contribute 95%.
